name: @gp/client
description: Expo app: Android APK + web export (Render static site)

scripts.start: node scripts/prepare-canvaskit.mjs && node scripts/prepare-registry.mjs && expo start --web --port 8090
scripts.web: node scripts/prepare-canvaskit.mjs && node scripts/prepare-registry.mjs && expo start --web --port 8090
scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-canvaskit.mjs && node scripts/prepare-registry.mjs && expo export -p web --output-dir dist && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/prepare-canvaskit.mjs --ts-only && node scripts/prepare-registry.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json
